The airport is serviced by QantasLink, using the [[Embraer E-Jet family|Embraer E190AR]], operated by [[Alliance Airlines]], for Brisbane Flights. QantasLink also operates Q400s to Sydney; Rex Airlines, who uses 36-seat [[Saab 340]]s on services to Sydney and formerly Melbourne.
